compiled_state.title: Create test-runners.yaml harness manifest (4 harnesses: engines, wrappers, invocation, verdict adapters)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml declares each participating harness with an invocation method and a verdict-extraction adapter
- dd-2: The manifest explicitly classifies bash-runner.sh and suite-engine.sh as independent engines and validate.sh and run-hook-tests.sh as wrappers naming their delegate engine
- dd-3: The manifest records that the bash-runner engine is invoked as the test-batched.sh --runner=bash composite

## Description
Create `plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml` as a flat YAML manifest with a top-level `harnesses:` list (mirroring the flat named-strategy style of sibling `plugins/dso/config/template-registry.yaml`). Each entry carries: `id` (authoritative harness identifier consumed by sibling sc-1 corpus + sc-3 test), `kind` enum (`engine`|`wrapper`), a structured `invocation` block, and a `verdict_adapter` field that is a NAME/PATH reference to a future sc-3 adapter function (reference only — NO adapter body; adapter logic deferred to sc-3 per Scope OUT). Declare all four harnesses:
- `bash-runner.sh`: kind=engine; invocation records the `test-batched.sh --runner=bash` composite command template (dd-3).
- `suite-engine.sh`: kind=engine; invocation method `direct-file-args`.
- `validate.sh`: kind=wrapper; delegate_engine: bash-runner.sh.
- `run-hook-tests.sh`: kind=wrapper; delegate_engine: suite-engine.sh.

Co-create the RED behavioral test `tests/runners/test-runners-manifest.sh` that parses the YAML with python yaml.safe_load and asserts on extracted values (NOT source grep). Prerequisite gating edits for the commit to pass the plugin-boundary pre-commit hook: add `plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml` AND `tests/runners/` to `.claude/hooks/pre-commit/plugin-boundary-allowlist.conf`; pin a `.test-index` entry mapping `plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml` -> `tests/runners/test-runners-manifest.sh` (source basename not fuzzy-matchable to the test basename); `chmod +x` the new test.

Gate 3 note: the three DDs are assertions over one declarative artifact created atomically; splitting would violate Gate 1 (neither half independently testable) / Gate 2 (incomplete manifest fails parse coherence).

## TDD Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml; When tests/runners/test-runners-manifest.sh parses it with python yaml.safe_load and inspects the harnesses list; Then it asserts (a) all four harnesses present each with non-empty invocation + verdict_adapter [dd-1]; (b) bash-runner.sh & suite-engine.sh kind=engine, validate.sh & run-hook-tests.sh kind=wrapper [dd-2]; (c) each wrapper's delegate_engine resolves to a declared engine id — dangling reference fails (cross-ref integrity); (d) bash-runner invocation records test-batched.sh --runner=bash composite [dd-3]. Fails RED before manifest exists, passes GREEN after.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Manifest is schema-valid YAML
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml')); print('OK')"
- [ ] RED test exists and is executable
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && test -x tests/runners/test-runners-manifest.sh
- [ ] RED test registered in .test-index mapping manifest to test
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && grep -Fq 'plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml' .test-index && grep -Fq 'tests/runners/test-runners-manifest.sh' .test-index
- [ ] Manifest and tests/runners allowlisted for the plugin-boundary hook
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && grep -Fq 'plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml' .claude/hooks/pre-commit/plugin-boundary-allowlist.conf && grep -Fq 'tests/runners/' .claude/hooks/pre-commit/plugin-boundary-allowlist.conf
- [ ] All four harnesses declared with id+invocation+verdict_adapter (dd-1)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python3 -c "import yaml; h={x['id']:x for x in yaml.safe_load(open('plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml'))['harnesses']}; want={'bash-runner.sh','suite-engine.sh','validate.sh','run-hook-tests.sh'}; assert want<=set(h); assert all(h[i].get('invocation') and h[i].get('verdict_adapter') for i in want); print('OK')"
- [ ] 2 engines kind=engine, 2 wrappers kind=wrapper each naming a declared delegate engine (dd-2)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python3 -c "import yaml; L=yaml.safe_load(open('plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml'))['harnesses']; h={x['id']:x for x in L}; eng={i for i in h if h[i]['kind']=='engine'}; assert h['bash-runner.sh']['kind']=='engine' and h['suite-engine.sh']['kind']=='engine'; assert h['validate.sh']['kind']=='wrapper' and h['run-hook-tests.sh']['kind']=='wrapper'; assert h['validate.sh']['delegate_engine'] in eng and h['run-hook-tests.sh']['delegate_engine'] in eng; print('OK')"
- [ ] bash-runner invocation records test-batched.sh --runner=bash composite (dd-3)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python3 -c "import yaml; h={x['id']:x for x in yaml.safe_load(open('plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml'))['harnesses']}; inv=str(h['bash-runner.sh']['invocation']); assert 'test-batched.sh' in inv and '--runner=bash' in inv; print('OK')"
- [ ] RED test asserts behaviorally (parses manifest, not source grep)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && grep -Eq 'yaml\.safe_load|safe_load' tests/runners/test-runners-manifest.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
